part1_demo.question: 各门店的复购用户数分别是多少

slots.subject: ads_member_repurchase_di
slots.granularity: 一行 = 一条 ads_member_repurchase_di 记录（主键 member_id）
slots.risks: 未确认的关键口径不得直接进入高置信输出

clarify.question: 取数时间按哪一个算？是业务发生的那天、状态变更的那天，还是数据加工入库的那天？

part1_demo.sql_draft: SELECT s.store_name, r.stat_month, SUM(r.repurchase_flag) AS 复购用户数 FROM ads_member_repurchase_di r JOIN dim_store s ON r.store_id = s.store_id GROUP BY s.store_name, r.stat_month

records.q: 2026年9月的复购用户数是多少
records.sql: SELECT SUM(repurchase_flag) AS 复购用户数 FROM ads_member_repurchase_di WHERE stat_month = '2026-09-01'

records.q: 按门店统计每月的复购用户数
records.sql: SELECT s.store_name, r.stat_month, SUM(r.repurchase_flag) AS 复购用户数 FROM ads_member_repurchase_di r JOIN dim_store s ON r.store_id = s.store_id GROUP BY s.store_name, r.stat_month

records.q: 2026年7月的复购用户数是多少
records.sql: SELECT SUM(repurchase_flag) AS 复购用户数 FROM ads_member_repurchase_di WHERE stat_month = '2026-07-01'

records.q: 整体复购率是多少（含分母）
records.sql: SELECT ROUND(CAST(100.0 * a.c / b.m AS DECIMAL(10,1)), 1) AS 复购率百分比, a.c AS 复购用户数, b.m AS 活跃会员数 FROM (SELECT SUM(repurchase_flag) AS c FROM ads_member_repurchase_di) a, (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT member_id) AS m FROM dwd_order_di) b

records.q: 各门店的复购用户数分别是多少
records.sql: SELECT s.store_name, r.stat_month, SUM(r.repurchase_flag) AS 复购用户数 FROM ads_member_repurchase_di r JOIN dim_store s ON r.store_id = s.store_id GROUP BY s.store_name, r.stat_month

records.q: 各归属门店的会员数是多少
records.sql: SELECT s.store_name AS 归属门店, COUNT(*) AS 会员数 FROM dim_member m JOIN dim_store s ON m.store_id = s.store_id GROUP BY s.store_name

records.q: 华东大区的销售额是多少（排除退款）
records.sql: SELECT SUM(o.pay_amount) AS 华东销售额 FROM dwd_order_di o JOIN dim_store s ON o.store_id = s.store_id WHERE s.region_name = '华东大区' AND o.order_status = '已完成'

records.q: 各大区的销售额分别是多少
records.sql: SELECT s.region_name AS 大区, SUM(o.pay_amount) AS 销售额 FROM dwd_order_di o JOIN dim_store s ON o.store_id = s.store_id WHERE o.order_status = '已完成' GROUP BY s.region_name

records.q: 各门店的销售额分别是多少
records.sql: SELECT s.store_name, SUM(o.pay_amount) AS 销售额 FROM dwd_order_di o JOIN dim_store s ON o.store_id = s.store_id WHERE o.order_status = '已完成' GROUP BY s.store_name

records.q: 各门店的日均销售额是多少
records.sql: SELECT s.store_name, ROUND(AVG(d.sales_amount), 2) AS 日均销售额 FROM dws_store_daily_agg d JOIN dim_store s ON d.store_id = s.store_id GROUP BY s.store_name

records.q: 各门店的坪效是多少
records.sql: SELECT s.store_name, ROUND(CAST(SUM(d.sales_amount) / MAX(d.area_sqm) AS DECIMAL(10,2)), 2) AS 坪效 FROM dws_store_daily_agg d JOIN dim_store s ON d.store_id = s.store_id GROUP BY s.store_name

records.q: 工作日和周末的销售额对比
records.sql: SELECT day_type, SUM(sales_amount) AS 销售额 FROM dws_store_daily_agg GROUP BY day_type

records.q: 各品类的销售额分别是多少
records.sql: SELECT category_name, SUM(sales_amount) AS 销售额 FROM dwd_order_detail_di GROUP BY category_name

records.q: 2026年9月会员升级的有多少人
records.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS 升级人数 FROM ads_member_grade_change_wi WHERE change_type = '升级' AND change_month >= '2026-09-01' AND change_month < '2026-10-01'

records.q: 会员升级和降级的数量分布
records.sql: SELECT change_type, COUNT(*) AS 数量 FROM ads_member_grade_change_wi GROUP BY change_type

records.q: 会员状态分布情况
records.sql: SELECT member_status AS 会员状态, COUNT(*) AS 人数 FROM dim_member GROUP BY member_status

records.q: 各等级的会员人数
records.sql: SELECT grade AS 会员等级, COUNT(*) AS 人数 FROM dim_member GROUP BY grade

records.q: 各门店的会员升降级数量
records.sql: SELECT s.store_name, g.change_type, COUNT(*) AS 数量 FROM ads_member_grade_change_wi g JOIN dim_member m ON g.member_id = m.member_id JOIN dim_store s ON m.store_id = s.store_id GROUP BY s.store_name, g.change_type

records.q: 每月的订单数和销售金额趋势
records.sql: SELECT date_trunc('month', order_date) AS 月份, COUNT(*) AS 订单数, SUM(pay_amount) AS 销售金额 FROM dwd_order_di WHERE order_status = '已完成' GROUP BY date_trunc('month', order_date) ORDER BY 月份

records.q: 2026年9月的活跃会员数（当月有下单）
records.sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT member_id) AS 活跃会员数 FROM dwd_order_di WHERE order_date >= '2026-09-01' AND order_date < '2026-10-01'
